item.description: UFC president Dana White says he doesn't like Josh Hokit's "shtick" but he has earned his heavyweight title shot against Ciryl Gane at UFC 334. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Surfing speedster Beardman gives a glimpse of Ashes future
item.description: Mahli Beardman gives England a glimpse into a possible Ashes future as he decimates their batting in Perth. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Spectacular try helps England to Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup glory
item.description: England has been crowned Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup champion for a third time, defeating France 50-38 as Australia finished its campaign with a comprehensive victory in the third-place play-off. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
